blurb: ROTAK Helicopter Services operates heavy-lift helicopters including CH-47D and K-MAX models for large external load missions. Their CH-47D helicopters can carry up to 26,000 pounds and are modified for external load use. The K-MAX helicopters are designed for repetitive precision external load operations and are cost effective and reliable.
